scope: Representative active-question and lesson evidence for all20 tasks. Not an exhaustive skill-level audit, predicted exam weighting or completion requirement.

tasks.title: Analyze requirements and design GenAI solutions.
tasks.scopeNote: Compare proof-of-concept quality, latency, cost and constraints; standardize tested components. These examples do not replace a full architecture review.

tasks.title: Select and configure FMs.
tasks.scopeNote: Evaluate capabilities, deployment control, compatible lifecycle artifacts and measured task cost; check current model and Region eligibility.

tasks.title: Implement data validation and processing pipelines for FM consumption.
tasks.scopeNote: Compare validation, extraction, sensitive-data discovery, transcription, normalization and provider-specific input formats; preserve failure and source evidence.

tasks.title: Design and implement vector store solutions.
tasks.scopeNote: Compare store architectures, approved metadata scope, measured partitioning and connector freshness. Capacity and backend support still require workload-specific validation rather than memorized universal settings.

tasks.title: Design retrieval mechanisms for FM augmentation.
tasks.scopeNote: Practice candidate recall, ranking, segmentation and query decomposition. The right retrieval configuration depends on authorized data and measured relevance.

tasks.title: Implement prompt engineering strategies and governance for FM interactions.
tasks.scopeNote: Version prompts and variables, preserve approval boundaries, test output contracts and retain the actual evaluated configuration.

tasks.title: Implement agentic AI solutions and tool integrations.
tasks.scopeNote: Separate tool discovery, versioned contracts, state, coordination and trusted execution authority. Framework examples do not establish exhaustive SDK coverage.

tasks.title: Implement model deployment strategies.
tasks.scopeNote: Match serving and deployment modes to runtime, capacity and documented feature exclusions; validate quality as well as successful traffic shifting.

tasks.title: Design and implement enterprise integration architectures.
tasks.scopeNote: Connect identity, scoped roles, infrastructure, immutable artifacts and approval gates. Hybrid/edge deployment details remain workload-specific.

tasks.title: Implement FM API integrations.
tasks.scopeNote: Validate provider-specific envelopes, compatible tool contracts, streaming assembly and routing; verify the precise selected model/API support.

tasks.title: Implement application integration patterns and development tools.
tasks.scopeNote: Use coding assistance with explicit review scope, meaningful tests and controlled integration checks. Follow current tooling support notices rather than frozen menu instructions.

tasks.title: Implement input and output safety controls.
tasks.scopeNote: Distinguish policy detection, enforcement, version requirements and infrastructure failure; test unsafe and legitimate cases across supported modalities.

tasks.title: Implement data security and privacy controls.
tasks.scopeNote: Bind retrieval, caches, logs and artifacts to current authorization and privacy requirements. Discovery results alone do not prove a corpus is free of sensitive data.

tasks.title: Implement AI governance and compliance mechanisms.
tasks.scopeNote: Combine intended-use records, lineage, approval and real access boundaries. Documentation and encryption do not by themselves establish regulatory compliance.

tasks.title: Implement responsible AI principles.
tasks.scopeNote: Evaluate fairness and calibrated human oversight alongside transparency and provenance. Aggregate scores cannot establish equal performance or universal safety.

tasks.title: Implement cost optimization and resource efficiency strategies.
tasks.scopeNote: Use total-cost estimates and observed reuse, volume and quality rather than assuming a serving mode or cache always reduces cost.

tasks.title: Optimize application performance.
tasks.scopeNote: Relate model loading, GPU memory, parallelism, concurrency and rollout capacity to measured latency and throughput for the selected runtime.

tasks.title: Implement monitoring systems for GenAI applications.
tasks.scopeNote: Track operational counts, rates and tail latency separately from semantic quality; correlate configurations and verify the availability of the monitoring service.

tasks.title: Implement evaluation systems for GenAI.
tasks.scopeNote: Practice model and agent evaluation, held-out datasets, judges, human review, reporting and quality gates. Check sampling, failures and denominators before comparing scores.

tasks.title: Troubleshoot GenAI applications.
tasks.scopeNote: Locate the earliest failed content, request, retrieval or tool boundary using correlated evidence; test the repair against both the failing case and a regression set.
